rubrics.justification: The response explicitly states no image was available and relies on the reported 3AA score rather than visible morphology, so it does not truly assess image features beyond generic Gardner-based descriptions.
It thoroughly integrates age, BMI, AMH, prior IVF outcomes, ectopic history, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis, though some probability adjustments and causal claims are somewhat speculative.

Core IVF concepts are aligned, but several recommendations (ERA, immunologic testing, microbiome testing, routine thrombophilia workup, PGT-A at age 25) go beyond or are not strongly supported by standard ESHRE/ASRM guidance.
Provides clear practical steps for transfer technique, luteal support, monitoring, and future workup, though some suggested tests may be excessive for this case.
